rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The judgment records that under the order of Mavundla J of 8 March 2019 the PAC was united under a leadership beginning "President, Mr Narius Moloto." and "Deputy President, Mr Nyntsho".

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The judgment's chronology reads "24-25 August 2019 : PAC hold Conference in Limpopo-Mr Narious Moloto is elected President."

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The same chronology reads "29-30 August 2019 : PAC hold Conference in Bloemfontein – Mr Mzwanele Nyontsho is elected President."

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The court declared that "The election of the First and Second Respondents as the President and the NEC of PAC" at the congress held at Limpopo on the 24th and 25th of August 2019 is "unlawful and invalid".

rows.role_title: President of the Pan Africanist Congress of Azania
rows.text: The court declared "The NEC of the PAC elected at the conference held on the 29th and the 30th August 2019 at Bloemfontein, to be lawful leadership of the PAC".

bounded_scope: PAC President observations for CLAUDE-C01-32 only (role za_pac_president on the PAN AFRICANIST CONGRESS OF AZANIA observation).
